title: Sennacherib sends his nobles against the Kullamean
summary: Sennacherib’s first year: the nobles are sent against the Kullamean in Tabal to avenge Sargon.
description: Sennacherib’s first year: the nobles are sent against the Kullamean in Tabal to avenge Sargon. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 3, row 704, p. 45; Table 2, row 704, pp. 41–42).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 704 BC (Sennacherib year 1).

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 3, row 704, p. 45; Table 2, row 704, pp. 41–42
chronologies.note: Sent against Tabal to avenge Sargon, unsuccessfully; omitted from Sennacherib’s annals. Merodach-Baladan organizes rebellion in Babylon. Eponym: Kalizi palace restored.
